Production Glossary · 37/50 · vfx

Clean plate

Definition

Clean plate is an image or shot of the scene without selected foreground elements, supplied for compositing and removal work. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align vfx decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

  • VFX pull
